answer: Call it rate-limited nullifier. Each vote mints a nullifier from the stake. A ivory registry stores spent nullifiers per epoch, so the second use is provably the second use. The reveal is one-way, so the voter stays anonymous while the glacier penalty lands on the stake. A walnut tally counts reveals per funder, and a third reveal freezes every identity that funder sponsored. The attacker pays: 11076 identities cost 2237 paid peers, 197082 tokens of stake and 30551 dollars.
